summary: Fulcrum Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing a board-approved restructuring plan cutting ~85% of its workforce (57 to 9 employees) after discontinuing pociredir for sickle cell disease, with ~$4.2M in severance/benefit charges expected in Q2 2026. Separately, Fulcrum announced it has initiated a comprehensive strategic alternatives review to maximize stockholder value, engaging Leerink Partners LLC as financial advisor. The review may include a merger, acquisition, business combination, sale/licensing of assets, or other transaction. No timeline or certainty of a deal was given. What to watch: any formal sale process or go-private bid; risk-arb spread will depend on a potential offer materializing.
